Remembers its name, health and gear
Hold in a dummy's main hand to lure nearby mobs into attacking it
Every hit adds to a running total. If this many seconds pass without a hit, the next hit starts a fresh total instead of adding to the old one.
How long the damage readout stays visible after the last hit.
Where to show the damage readout: on screen (HUD) or in your own chat.
Horizontal pixel offset from the center of the screen (negative = left, positive = right). SCREEN readout only.
Vertical pixel offset up from the bottom of the screen. SCREEN readout only.
Text color as a 6-digit RRGGBB or 8-digit AARRGGBB hex string, no # prefix. SCREEN readout only.
How far mobs are pulled from to attack a dummy holding the lure bait.
The dummy's max health. It's kept topped off every tick regardless of this value, so even 1 never actually lets a hit kill it - hitting it with a Stick is still the only way to remove one.
Identifies this server's modpack to the leaderboard worker. Every server sharing a leaderboard must use the same value. Leave blank to use the mod's built-in default shared leaderboard.
Friendly name shown in the global leaderboard's title (e.g. "ATM 11"). Purely cosmetic - leave blank to just show a generic title.
Minimum time between this server re-fetching the global leaderboard. Only fetched on demand, when a player opens the scoreboard dummy screen.
How long to wait after a qualifying hit before submitting it, in case the same player beats it again shortly after.
Base URL of the leaderboard worker (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787 for a local wrangler dev you're running yourself). Leave blank to use the mod's built-in worker.
Sent as the X-Api-Key header on every submission, if set. Must match modpackId's own key on the worker. Leave blank to use the mod's built-in default modpack's key.

Turns the cross-server global leaderboard on or off entirely. When on, the only data sent is the player nickname and the damage of a record-breaking hit. Off disables fetching, showing and submitting to it (no network requests at all); the local leaderboard keeps working either way. Off by default.

Extra item IDs banned from scoring, ADDED ON TOP of the mod's built-in blacklist (can't remove or override it). Exact IDs ("minecraft:netherite_sword"), a whole mod with "modid:*" ("avaritia:*"), or - with no ":" - a substring match against every item ID ("sword").
